about_the_game:
The doors of Blackwood Manor seal shut with a finality that echoes in your bones. You came seeking answers, now you'll fight for your sanity.

Quiet Soul is a first-person psychological horror experience where the true monster is the house itself. This is not about running or fighting—it's about observing, deducing, and surviving an architecture designed to disquiet the soul. You will navigate decaying grandeur, where every creaking floorboard and dusty ledger holds a piece of a shattered past.

Designed for the contemplative horror fan, the game replaces jump-scares with sustained dread and replaces combat with cerebral challenge. The mansion watches, waits, and reveals its secrets only to those who dare to look closer.

Key Features:

  • Atmosphere as an Antagonist: Immerse yourself in a world of dynamic shadows, haunting sound design, and meticulously crafted decay. The mansion's silence is more terrifying than any scream.

  • Puzzles Woven into the World: Solve mysteries that are organically integrated into the environment. Decipher family portraits, align celestial devices in the observatory, and replay tragic events through found memories to unlock new paths.

  • A Story Told by the Walls: Piece together the manor's tragic narrative solely through environmental clues, cryptic notes, and distorted echoes of the past. Uncover the truth at your own pace.

  • Nonlinear, Clue-Driven Exploration: The mansion opens based on your discoveries. Your curiosity and logic chart the course, with no forced progression or scripted chases.

  • The Tension of Isolation: Experience the profound unease of being utterly alone in a place that feels anything but empty. The horror stems from anticipation and the unsettling knowledge that you are unraveling something meant to stay buried.

  • The Ultimate Escape: Every solved puzzle is a step toward freedom, but each revelation may make you question if you truly want to leave. Can you escape without becoming part of the house's legacy?

Quiet Soul is a love letter to classic Gothic horror and thoughtful puzzle design. It's for players who found solace in the tension of Gone Home, the intricate puzzles of The Room, and the immersive dread of Amnesia—stripped back to a pure, psychological core.

Do you have the quiet resolve to face what lingers here?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Step into the silent dread of a forgotten estate. Unravel its tragic history through environmental puzzles and hidden clues. Your mind is your only tool to escape the mansion's grip.
